formula_sql:
SELECT
  transaction_type, event, accountable_type,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  SUM(settled_amount) AS total
FROM zs_observe.jiomart_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type IN ('Credit Note', 'Debit Note', 'Service Invoice', 'Bill Tds Refund')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3;
